experiments.title: Android local job/result bridge
experiments.present: Samsung Android 16 on 2026-10-21: owner confirmed real Android→Termux DOCTOR and STATUS callback; local status CLI returned historical successful signed preview APK on older two-core commit 91291cb2. New current-feature app→Termux BUILD callback, lease/authenticated replay and owner device-tested artifact are NOT proven. Only fixed commands, request IDs and one-shot Android callback allowed. Argon review: native single-active-job guard already rejects a second STATUS/DOCTOR/BUILD request during pending BUILD. On integration branch, receipt hardening now binds callback operation/UUID in URI and validates 40-hex commit, preview package, versionCode and existing sha256/signer, with Termux err == -1. These new changes require device runtime verification; owner Samsung 0.3.10 does not yet include them. Sol M4: two allowlisted hash-bound project plans, persistent private build evidence and read-only project status, separate one-shot recovery slot preserving MAIN callback; actual SDK compile, 873 JUnit cases including 8 Robolectric UI cases passed. Current phone callback/SELinux/cancellation remains unverified.
experiments.depends: Versioned job IDs, authenticated IPC and user grants
experiments.gate: On the current integrated source, app-button BUILD must actually produce a validated Android→Termux→App completion receipt with exact Git commit/SHA/signing/package verification; inspect replay/lease and failure paths. No automatic installation. Include operation-id URI identity, payload binding and negative tests for missing/wrong commit/package/version. Never claim current-source M1 closed before an actual Android->Termux->Android BUILD callback and independently checked commit.
